description: This file defines interfaces and includes dependencies for a cryptography module, with support for different SSL libraries (mbedTLS, wolfSSL, OpenSSL). It includes function prototypes for cipher management and encryption/decryption operations.

methods.name: get_cipher_or_print_error
methods.description: Retrieves cipher object by name or prints an error.

methods.name: get_cipher_ivsize
methods.description: Returns the IV size of the specified cipher.

methods.name: get_cipher_keysize
methods.description: Returns the key size of the specified cipher.

methods.name: create_ctx
methods.description: Creates and initializes a cryptographic context with specified cipher, key, IV, operation mode, and padding.

methods.name: do_crypt
methods.description: Performs encryption or decryption on data from input file to output file using the specified context.

methods.name: free_ctx
methods.description: Frees and deallocates the cryptographic context.
